source: NOAA Fisheries, Office of Habitat Conservation, Habitat Areas of Particular Concern (NOAA Fisheries' ArcGIS Online, HAPC), combined from each region's and each council's — a U.S. Government work
notice: Although these data have been used by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, no warranty expressed or implied is made by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration as to the accuracy of the data. The HAPC designation alone does not confer additional protection or restrictions to an area.
caveat: Emergency and in-season closures are not in these files: they close a fishery for a time by notice (the Federal Register, a regional office's bulletin), not by a new boundary. A management area's GIS is not its legal definition; the regulation's text is.
